/-- Run of H44 (§71, §76–§78; HandlePool v0.5, D.1–D.3): frame 1 with the arena value 0,
the allocator 1, the pool value 2 and the handle leaves 3 and 4; storage 5 owned by 0, with the
place 6 holding the nodes 7 (fields 8, 9) and 10 (fields 11, 12); arena on 5 (`internal` 5); the
block 6 over the leaves of 6 issued to the pool value; pool on 6 with the block as `internal`;
each node resolved in turn, its link field written, then unresolved; `endUse` of the pool value;
`reset` of the arena. -/
def h44o : List COp := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 1 0 [lf, pt 5, pt 6, pt 7, pt 7, pt 6, pt 10, pt 10], .write 0 [0], .newArena 5 5,
  .issue 0 [8, 9, 11, 12] 2, .newPool 6 6, .allocSlot 0 3, .allocSlot 0 4,
  .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify, .write 8 [8, 9], .unresolve 7,
  .resolve 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩ .modify, .write 10 [11, 12], .unresolve 9, .endUse 2, .reset 0]

/-- **H44** (material §1 G, class Lib). A cyclic graph whose nodes live in a pool placed on an arena
block, linked by handles; temporary resolutions; end of the resolutions, then of the pool value,
then `reset` of the arena, without following the cyclic links. Expected (material): `ok`.
Obtained: `ok` at every step (§89, §37, §78.2; HandlePool v0.5, D.1: the block region was never
written, so `newPool` finds `Uninit` storage). -/
theorem H44 : CRuns K0 [] h44o :=
  crunsTo (by decide)

/-! ## Handle-pool contract (HandlePool v0.5) -/

/-- State after the first nine steps of `h44o`: the pool on the arena block, both slots allocated,
nothing resolved (§57). -/
def fdi : CState := cfinal K0 [] (h44o.take 9)

/-- **pool_freeSlot_derived_internal** (handle-pool contract, class Lib). `freeSlot` on a pool
whose `internal` is a derived authority (the arena block 6) held by the pool value, outside the
slot. Expected (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "aucune autorité active ne couvre l'entrée hors
`internal` et ses ancêtres"; "Le contrôle n'interprète pas `internal` comme un emprunt externe";
HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1': only strict descendants of `internal` block): `ok`. Obtained: `ok` (the
entry was never written and no active strict descendant of `internal` 6 covers it).

The kernel `endUse` of the slot place 7 on the same state. Historical verdict: `reject` (spec v0
§69.2: `internal` 6, active, derived, covering the slot, is held outside it; the exemption of
`internal` then decided the `freeSlot` verdict of the v0.4 annex, whose `freeSlot` ended the
content). New verdict: `ok` (v0.1 §69.2, the exemption of the authority on which the `Modify`
right over the place rests and of its origin chain: that right over the place 7 rests on 6).
Obtained: `ok` (`EndUsePre`). Under HandlePool v0.5 `freeSlot` has no end-of-use effect (HP5-1),
so the two verdicts no longer depend on each other. -/
theorem pool_freeSlot_derived_internal : CRunsTo K0 [] (h44o.take 9) fdi ∧
    EndUsePre K0 fdi.kern 7 ∧ CRuns K0 [] (h44o.take 9 ++ [.freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩]) :=
  ⟨crunsTo (by decide), by decide, crunsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- **resolveMany_observe_repeat** (handle-pool contract, class Lib). `resolveMany` in
`Observe` of a repeated valid handle. Expected (HandlePool v0.5, D.2: "sans `split` ni
contrôle de distinction : la répétition du même handle valide est permise"): `ok`. Obtained: `ok`
(one `Observe` companion, two `Observe` entry authorities derived from it, §60). The same batch in
`Modify` is `fail` (`H31b`). -/
theorem resolveMany_observe_repeat :
    CRuns K0 [] (h31bo ++ [.resolveMany 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .observe]) :=
  crunsTo (by decide)

/-- **resolveMany_atomic** (handle-pool contract, class Lib). `resolveMany Modify` of a batch with
one valid handle and one stale handle. Expected (HandlePool v0.5, D.2: "`fail` atomique, sans
création partielle de droits"; HP5-5): `fail`. Obtained: `fail`, and `fail` is the only outcome of
the relation (no authority is created, §58). Twin without the stale handle (the two valid
handles): `ok`. -/
theorem resolveMany_atomic :
    HandlePool.ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 1, 5⟩] .modify h31b.toP .fail ∧
    (∀ o, HandlePool.ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 1, 5⟩] .modify h31b.toP o →
      o = .fail) ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (h31bo ++ [.resolveMany 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 1, 0⟩] .modify]) :=
  ⟨cfails (k := K0) (C := h31b) (o := .resolveMany 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 1, 5⟩] .modify) (by decide),
    (HandlePool.pool_resolveMany_invalid_fails (k := K0) (L := h31b.toP) (j := 0)
      (pl := ⟨0, 4, 4, [⟨5, 0, true⟩, ⟨6, 0, true⟩]⟩) (hs := [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 1, 5⟩])
      (m := .modify) (by decide) (by decide)).2,
    crunsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of `pool_newPool_written` (§72, §71, §67): the pool base with the entry 5 written before
`newPool`. -/
def pnwo : List COp := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, pt 4, pt 4], .write 4 [5]]
/-- State reached by `pnwo` (§57). -/
def pnw : CState := cfinal K0 [] pnwo

/-- **pool_newPool_written** (handle-pool contract, class Lib; the draft witness
`pool_allocSlot_content_init`). `newPool` on a storage whose leaf 5 was written. Expected
(HandlePool v0.5, D.1: "`newPool(storage, internal)` exige que toutes les feuilles du stockage
d'entrée soient `Uninit`"): `reject`. Obtained: `reject`; the other preconditions (those of
`newArena`, §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6, and the guard of §56) hold. Twin without the write:
`newPool` and `allocSlot` are `ok`. -/
theorem pool_newPool_written : CRunsTo K0 [] pnwo pnw ∧
    HandlePool.NewPoolStep pnw.othersP 4 4 pnw.toP .reject ∧
    NewArenaBase pnw.kern 4 4 ∧ Guard56 (HandlePool.liveInternals pnw.kern pnw.pools ::
      pnw.othersP) 4 ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (pb ++ [.allocSlot 0 2]) :=
  ⟨crunsTo (by decide), crejects (k := K0) (C := pnw) (o := .newPool 4 4) (by decide), by decide,
    by decide, crunsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- State reached by `pb` (§57): a fresh pool, both slots free. -/
def pb0 : CState := cfinal K0 [] pb

/-- **pool_free_entry_handle** (handle-pool contract, class Lib). `freeSlot` of a free slot whose
identity and generation match the handle. Historical expected verdict: not `ok`, `fail` or `reject`
to arbitrate (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "un slot déjà libre n'est pas rendu libérable par cette
seule égalité"; the pool module read it as `fail`, HandlePool reading H-R2, a mismatch in form).
New expected verdict: `fail` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-6, arbitration Q12: "un handle d'entrée libre
est périmé : fail"; HP5-1'': `fail` on an invalid handle). Obtained: `fail`; `resolveMany` of the
same handle is `fail` too (HP5-5, HP5-6). Twins, the slot allocated first: `freeSlot` is `ok`;
`resolveMany` is `ok`. -/
theorem pool_free_entry_handle : CRunsTo K0 [] pb pb0 ∧
    HandlePool.FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ pb0.toP .fail ∧
    HandlePool.ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .modify pb0.toP .fail ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (pb ++ [.allocSlot 0 2, .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩]) ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (pb ++ [.allocSlot 0 2, .resolveMany 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .modify]) :=
  ⟨crunsTo (by decide), cfails (k := K0) (C := pb0) (o := .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩) (by decide),
    cfails (k := K0) (C := pb0) (o := .resolveMany 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .modify) (by decide),
    crunsTo (by decide), crunsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of `pool_dead` (§69): slot 0 allocated (handle in 2), then `endUse` of the pool value 1,
which releases `internal` (§69 effect: the authorities held by the place end). -/
def pdo : List COp := pb ++ [.allocSlot 0 2, .endUse 1]
/-- State reached by `pdo` (§57). -/
def pd : CState := cfinal K0 [] pdo

/-- **pool_dead** (handle-pool contract, class Lib). `allocSlot` and `freeSlot` on a pool whose
`internal` is no longer active; `internal` 4 is inactive while `MetaRight` (§36, `Modify` over the
pool value) still holds. `allocSlot`: expected (HandlePool v0.5, D.3: "`allocSlot(pool, dst)` exige
un pool vivant") `reject`; obtained `reject`. `freeSlot`: historical expected verdict `reject`
(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "`freeSlot(h)` exige un pool **vivant**", a precondition checked
before the handle); new expected verdict `fail` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1'', arbitration Q5 extended
to `freeSlot`: "le handle d'un pool mort donne fail"); obtained `fail`. Twins without the `endUse`:
`allocSlot` and `freeSlot` are `ok`. -/
theorem pool_dead : CRunsTo K0 [] pdo pd ∧ ¬ pd.kern.Active 4 ∧
    MetaRight pd.kern ⟨4, 4, [], []⟩ ∧
    HandlePool.AllocSlotStep 0 3 pd.toP .reject ∧
    HandlePool.FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ pd.toP .fail ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (pb ++ [.allocSlot 0 2, .allocSlot 0 3]) ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (pb ++ [.allocSlot 0 2, .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩]) :=
  ⟨crunsTo (by decide), by decide, by decide,
    crejects (k := K0) (C := pd) (o := .allocSlot 0 3) (by decide),
    cfails (k := K0) (C := pd) (o := .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩) (by decide), crunsTo (by decide),
    crunsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- Test contract of `pool_shared_right` (§68.1, §80): the pool value 1 is `SharedMutable`. -/
abbrev KSh : K := KD.toK { shared := [1] }

/-- Run of `pool_shared_right` (§60, §72, §68): slot 0 allocated; the caller passes 5, `Observe`
on the pool value, to a callee with the local 7, which updates the pool metadata by
`writeShared`. -/
def psro : List COp := pb ++ [.allocSlot 0 2, .derive 1 [1] .observe, .enter [5] [lf],
  .writeShared 5 [1]]
/-- State reached by `psro` (§57). -/
def psr : CState := cfinal KSh [] psro

/-- **pool_shared_right** (handle-pool contract, class Lib; the draft witness
`pool_freeSlot_shared_right`). A callee that may update the pool metadata only by `writeShared`
calls `allocSlot` and `freeSlot`. Expected (§36: `MetaRight` requires `Modify` exercisable on the
administering value, the `writeShared` branch alone is insufficient; this overrides the
`writeShared` right of material §4 and of HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3): `reject`, `reject`.
Obtained: the `writeShared` is `ok` (§68), `allocSlot` and `freeSlot` are `reject` (`¬ MetaRight`;
the handle of `freeSlot` is valid, so the right decides, HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1''). Twin, the same
run with a `Modify` parameter on the pool value: `allocSlot` then `freeSlot` are `ok` (the
`freeSlot` under the `Modify` right). -/
theorem pool_shared_right : CRunsTo KSh [] psro psr ∧ ¬ MetaRight psr.kern ⟨4, 4, [], []⟩ ∧
    HandlePool.AllocSlotStep 0 7 psr.toP .reject ∧
    HandlePool.FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ psr.toP .reject ∧
    CRuns KSh [] (pb ++ [.allocSlot 0 2, .derive 1 [1] .modify, .enter [5] [lf],
      .writeShared 5 [1], .allocSlot 0 7, .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩]) :=
  ⟨crunsTo (by decide), by decide, crejects (k := KSh) (C := psr) (o := .allocSlot 0 7) (by decide),
    crejects (k := KSh) (C := psr) (o := .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩) (by decide), crunsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- Base of `pool_two_freeSlot_cross` (§72, §71, §60, §65; HandlePool v0.5, D.1): frame 1 with
the allocator 0, the pool value 1 and the leaves 2, 3, 4; storage 5 (entries 6, 7) owned by 1,
pool 0 on it with `internal` its root 5; then 6, `Modify` on the whole storage from 5, stored into
the leaf 4. -/
def pxo : List COp := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, pt 5, pt 5], .newPool 5 5, .derive 5 [6, 7] .modify, .store 6 4]
/-- State reached by `pxo` (§57). -/
def px : CState := cfinal K0 [] pxo
/-- The twin of `pool_two_freeSlot_cross` continued as the draft witness, up to its `freeSlot`:
pool 1 on `internal` 6 over the same storage; slot 0 allocated in each pool (the place 6 in both);
the leaf 6 written through 6. -/
def pxwo : List COp := pxo ++ [.newPool 5 6, .allocSlot 0 2, .allocSlot 1 3, .write 6 [6]]
/-- State reached by `pxwo` (§57). -/

/-- State reached by `pxwo` (§57). -/
def pxw : CState := cfinal K0 [] pxwo
/-- The same continuation without the write, then `freeSlot` of slot 0 of pool 1 (HandlePool
v0.5, HP5-1). -/
def pxto : List COp := pxo ++ [.newPool 5 6, .allocSlot 0 2, .allocSlot 1 3, .freeSlot 1 ⟨1, 0, 0⟩]
/-- State reached by `pxto` (§57). -/
def pxt : CState := cfinal K0 [] pxto

/-- **pool_two_freeSlot_cross** (handle-pool contract, class Lib). A second pool on the `internal`
5 of the live pool 0, over the same storage. Expected (§56; HandlePool v0.5, D.1: "Une autorité ne
peut être `internal` de deux abstractions vivantes"): `reject` at the second `newPool`. Obtained:
`reject`; the other preconditions hold. Twin, the second pool on the distinct `internal` 6 (§56:
distinct identities over overlapping footprints are not forbidden): `ok`.

That twin continued as the draft witness: each pool allocates its slot 0, the place 6; the leaf 6
is written through 6; then `freeSlot` of slot 0 of pool 1. Historical verdict of this `freeSlot`:
`ok`, ending the content of the place 6, a live slot of pool 0 (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: the
`internal` 5 of pool 0, an ancestor of the `internal` 6 of pool 1, is exempt). New verdict:
`reject` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1: no leaf of the entry may be `Init`; the leaf 6 is `Init`).
Obtained: `reject`. Twin without the write: `ok`; the leaf 6 stays `Uninit` and the slot 0 of
pool 0 stays live at generation 0 (`freeSlot` has no kernel effect, HP5-1). On that state pool 0
cannot resolve its slot while the `internal` 6 of pool 1 is active: its own `internal` 5 has no
effective right on the storage (`reject`, §43 case 3). Twin of that `reject`: the same sequence
without the authority 6 (its `derive` and `store`) and the steps that use it (pool 1, its slot, its
`freeSlot`): `allocSlot` then `resolve` in pool 0, `ok`. Dropping only the steps of pool 1 does not
lift the `reject`: 6 is active from its `derive` on, before pool 1 exists. -/
theorem pool_two_freeSlot_cross : CRunsTo K0 [] pxo px ∧
    HandlePool.NewPoolStep px.othersP 5 5 px.toP .reject ∧ NewArenaBase px.kern 5 5 ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint px.kern.P 5, px.kern.I l = .uninit) ∧
    CRunsTo K0 [] pxwo pxw ∧ pxw.kern.I 6 = .init ∧
    HandlePool.FreeSlotStep 1 ⟨1, 0, 0⟩ pxw.toP .reject ∧
    CRunsTo K0 [] pxto pxt ∧ pxt.kern.I 6 = .uninit ∧
    pxt.pools = [⟨0, 5, 5, [⟨6, 0, true⟩, ⟨7, 0, false⟩]⟩,
      ⟨1, 5, 6, [⟨6, 1, false⟩, ⟨7, 0, false⟩]⟩] ∧
    HandlePool.ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify pxt.toP .reject ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (pxo.take 5 ++ [.allocSlot 0 2, .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify]) :=
  ⟨crunsTo (by decide), crejects (k := K0) (C := px) (o := .newPool 5 5) (by decide), by decide,
    by decide, crunsTo (by decide), by decide,
    crejects (k := K0) (C := pxw) (o := .freeSlot 1 ⟨1, 0, 0⟩) (by decide),
    crunsTo (by decide), by decide, by decide,
    crejects (k := K0) (C := pxt) (o := .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify) (by decide),
    crunsTo (by decide)⟩

/-! ## Usage scenarios W1, W2 (material §5b) -/

/-- Run of W1 (§72, §71, §67, §63; HandlePool v0.5, D.1–D.3, HP5-1): frame 1 with the allocator
0, the pool value 1, the handle leaves 2 and 3, and two locals of the shape of a node, 4 (fields 5,
6, 7) and 8 (fields 9, 10, 11); storage 12 owned by the pool value, with the nodes 13 (fields
`data` 14, `parent` 15, `child` 16) and 17 (fields 18, 19, 20); pool on 12, its `internal` the

of the first node to write its data. The value of the second node is then removed (arbitration
Q21, along the path of the Q3 witness): `resolve Modify` (companion 13, entry 14), write of its
last field not yet written (20), `transfer` of the entry to the local 4, `unresolve`. Last,
`freeSlot` of the second node, still designated by the child field of the first. -/
def w1o : List COp := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, pt 4, pt 4, pt 4, lf, pt 8, pt 8, pt 8],
  .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, pt 12, pt 13, pt 13, pt 13, pt 12, pt 17, pt 17, pt 17], .newPool 12 6,
  .allocSlot 0 2, .allocSlot 0 3,
  .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify, .write 8 [14, 16], .unresolve 7,
  .resolve 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩ .modify, .write 10 [18, 19], .unresolve 9,
  .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify, .write 12 [14], .unresolve 11,
  .resolve 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩ .modify, .write 14 [20], .transfer 17 4, .unresolve 13,
  .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩]
/-- State reached by `w1o` (§57). -/
def w1 : CState := cfinal K0 [] w1o
/-- State of the historical run of W1 just before its `freeSlot`: the first 16 steps of `w1o`,
the value of the second node not removed (§57). -/
def w1l : CState := cfinal K0 [] (w1o.take 16)
/-- W1 continued by a resolution of the first node (companion 15, entry 16), the write of its
field 15 and the `transfer` of its value to the local 8, the resolution still active (arbitration
Q21; §57). -/
def w1bo : List COp := w1o ++ [.resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify, .write 16 [15], .transfer 13 8]
/-- State reached by `w1bo` (§57). -/
def w1b : CState := cfinal K0 [] w1bo

/-- **W1** (material §5b, scene graph; class Lib, not given by the material). Expected (material):
every step `ok`; `resolve` of the stale handle of the freed node `fail`; `freeSlot` during an
active resolution `reject`.

Historical run: the `freeSlot` of the second node right after its fields were written, `ok`,
ending its written content (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3). Under HandlePool v0.5 that `freeSlot` is
`reject` (HP5-1: no leaf of the entry may be `Init`; the fields 18 and 19 are), stated on the state
`w1l`. Arbitration Q21 revises the case: the value is removed before `freeSlot`, by
`resolve Modify`, write, `transfer` of the entry to a local and `unresolve` (the path of the Q3
witness, HandlePool v0.5, HP5-2); the same removal precedes the `freeSlot` of the first node. New
expected verdicts: every step of the revised run `ok`; the other verdicts unchanged. For the
`transfer` 17 → 4 the verdict is decided by v0.1 §63.4: the companion 13 and the entry 14, active
derived authorities held outside the source, cover it, but the `Modify` right over 17 rests on 14,
whose origin chain contains 13, so both are exempt (spec v0 §63.4, without the exemption, rejects
that `transfer`); the same exemption decides the `transfer` 13 → 8 of `w1bo` (the right rests on
the entry 16, the companion 15 on its origin chain). For the `freeSlot` it is decided by
HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 and HP5-1' (no leaf of the entry `Init`; no active strict descendant of
`internal` 6 covers it).

Obtained: every step `ok`; after the run the fields of the second node are `Moved` and the local 4
is `Init` (§63 effect). `resolve` of the stale handle `fail` (§89; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-5, HP5-6:
the slot is free at generation 1). `freeSlot` of the first node while it is resolved, its value
already moved to the local 8, `reject` (HP5-1': its companion 15 and entry 16, active strict
descendants of `internal` 6, cover it; the resolution is the only fault). Twins: the handle of the
live first node resolves (`ok`, the first step after `w1o` in `w1bo`); after `unresolve 15`, the
`freeSlot` is `ok`; the twin of the historical `reject` is the revised run. -/
theorem W1 : CRunsTo K0 [] w1o w1 ∧
    w1.pools = [⟨0, 12, 6, [⟨13, 0, true⟩, ⟨17, 1, false⟩]⟩] ∧
    CRunsTo K0 [] (w1o.take 16) w1l ∧ w1l.kern.I 18 = .init ∧
    HandlePool.FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩ w1l.toP .reject ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint w1.kern.P 17, w1.kern.I l = .moved) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint w1.kern.P 4, w1.kern.I l = .init) ∧
    HandlePool.ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩ .modify w1.toP .fail ∧
    CRunsTo K0 [] w1bo w1b ∧ HandlePool.FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ w1b.toP .reject ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (w1bo ++ [.unresolve 15, .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩]) :=
  ⟨crunsTo (by decide), by decide, crunsTo (by decide), by decide,
    crejects (k := K0) (C := w1l) (o := .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩) (by decide), by decide, by decide,
    cfails (k := K0) (C := w1) (o := .resolve 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩ .modify) (by decide),
    crunsTo (by decide), crejects (k := K0) (C := w1b) (o := .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩) (by decide),
    crunsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of W2 (§72, §71, §61, §60, §66, §67, §62; HandlePool v0.5, D.2): frame 1 with the
allocator 0, the owners 1 and 2 of two archetypes, the entity pool value 3 and the handle leaves
4, 5, 6. Archetype 7 (columns 8 with rows 9, 10 and 11 with rows 12, 13) owned by 1; archetype 14
(columns 15 with 16, 17 and 18 with 19, 20) owned by 2; entity storage 21 (entries 22, 23, 24)
owned by 3, pool on it. `split` of archetype 7 into its columns (authorities 10 and 11); system B
writes column 2 and takes a read view 12 on it; system A writes column 1 while B reads through
its view; `resolveMany Modify` of three distinct entities (companion 13, entries 14–16);
system A, done, releases its column authority 10. -/
def w2o : List COp := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .write 2 [2], .write 3 [3],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, pt 7, pt 8, pt 8, pt 7, pt 11, pt 11],
  .alloc 0 2 [lf, pt 14, pt 15, pt 15, pt 14, pt 18, pt 18],
  .alloc 0 3 [lf, pt 21, pt 21, pt 21], .newPool 21 9,
  .allocSlot 0 4, .allocSlot 0 5, .allocSlot 0 6,
  .split 7 [[9, 10], [12, 13]], .write 11 [12, 13], .derive 11 [12, 13] .observe,
  .write 10 [9, 10], .read 12 [12, 13], .resolveMany 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 1, 0⟩, ⟨0, 2, 0⟩] .modify,
  .release 10]
/-- State reached by `w2o` (§57). -/
def w2 : CState := cfinal K0 [] w2o
/-- State after `w2o` and the release of the read view 12 (§57). -/
def w2a : CState := cfinal K0 [] (w2o ++ [.release 12])

/-- **W2** (material §5b, ECS archetype and sparse set; class Lib, not given by the material).
Expected (material): disjoint reads and writes `ok`; `resolveMany` `ok`; the move of a row (the
transfers of its fields) while a column view is active `reject`; after its release `ok`.
Arbitration Q21 makes the variant the case: the column view is the column authority 11 with its
read view 12, and its release is the release of 12 and 11. Obtained: disjoint accesses and
`resolveMany` `ok`; the transfer of the field 12 into 19 while the view lives `reject` (the read
view 12, an active `Observe` derivative of 11, leaves no authority with effective `Modify` on the
field: §43 case 4, §63.1); after the release of 12 and 11, the move (transfers 9 → 16 and
12 → 19) is `ok`.

Re-evaluation under the exemption of v0.1 §63.4 (follow-up answer to Q3), on the state `w2a` after
the release of the read view 12 alone: the column authority 11 still covers the field from outside
the source (`ActiveDerivedOutside`), but it is the authority on which the `Modify` right over the
field rests (`Grounds`). In the case (the variant) the column view is then still active, so the
verdict of the move in `w2a` changes with v0.1. Historical expected verdict: `reject` (material:
the move of a row while a column view is active; spec v0 §63.4: 11, active, derived and held
outside the field, covers it; the v0 edition obtained `reject`). New expected verdict: `ok`,
decided by v0.1 §63.4 ("except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right
over `source`: the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"): 11 and
its origins are exempt, the read view 12 is released and the authorities of `resolveMany` cover
the entity storage only. Obtained: `ok`. Limit of the case: in this run of one frame the move
exercises its right through the column authority 11 itself, so the variant no longer expresses a
move by another system while the view lives; whether the case needs another revision is left to
the user. On the literal reading (the view = the read view 12 alone, expected `ok` after its
release), spec v0 rejected this move, the MISMATCH of the v0 edition; under v0.1 that reading
obtains its expected verdicts as well. -/
theorem W2 : CRunsTo K0 [] w2o w2 ∧ TransferStep K0 12 19 w2.kern .reject ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (w2o ++ [.release 12, .release 11, .transfer 9 16, .transfer 12 19]) ∧
    CRunsTo K0 [] (w2o ++ [.release 12]) w2a ∧ ActiveDerivedOutside w2a.kern 12 11 ∧
    Grounds w2a.kern .modify 12 11 ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (w2o ++ [.release 12, .transfer 9 16, .transfer 12 19]) :=
  ⟨crunsTo (by decide), crejects (k := K0) (C := w2) (o := .transfer 12 19) (by decide),
    crunsTo (by decide), crunsTo (by decide), by decide, by decide, crunsTo (by decide)⟩

end Ern.Corpus.Lib

/-- The relation of `o` from `C` (§58, §60–§78; HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2), on the projection
it acts on: `OpRel` of `Ern.Corpus` for O1–O16, `issue` and `reset`; `newArena`, `newPool`,
`newStack` with the internals of every other live registry as their guard parameter (§56,
§76.4); the relations of the pool and stack modules. -/
def CRel (k : K) (C : CState) : COp → Outcome3 CState → Prop
  | .derive a r m => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.derive a r m)) C.setL
  | .split a rs => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.split a rs)) C.setL
  | .release a => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.release a)) C.setL
  | .transfer a b => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.transfer a b)) C.setL
  | .depend q x => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.depend q x)) C.setL
  | .enter ps ls => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.enter ps ls)) C.setL
  | .exit => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL .exit) C.setL
  | .read a ls => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.read a ls)) C.setL
  | .write a ls => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.write a ls)) C.setL
  | .writeShared a ls => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.writeShared a ls)) C.setL
  | .pin p => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.pin p)) C.setL
  | .unpin o => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.unpin o)) C.setL
  | .endUse p => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.endUse p)) C.setL
  | .free p a => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.free p a)) C.setL
  | .alloc pr ow ls => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.alloc pr ow ls)) C.setL
  | .store a p => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.store a p)) C.setL
  | .newArena st i => LiftR (NewArenaStep C.othersA st i C.toL) C.setL
  | .issue i r d => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.issue i r d)) C.setL
  | .reset i => LiftR (OpRel k C.toL (.reset i)) C.setL
  | .newPool st i => LiftR (HandlePool.NewPoolStep C.othersP st i C.toP) C.setP
  | .allocSlot j d => LiftR (HandlePool.AllocSlotStep j d C.toP) C.setP
  | .resolve j h m => LiftR (HandlePool.ResolveStep j h m C.toP) C.setP
  | .resolveMany j hs m => LiftR (HandlePool.ResolveManyStep k j hs m C.toP) C.setP
  | .unresolve c => LiftR (HandlePool.UnresolveStep c C.toP) C.setP
  | .freeSlot j h => LiftR (HandlePool.FreeSlotStep j h C.toP) C.setP
  | .newStack st i => LiftR (DataStack.NewStackStep C.othersD st i C.toD) C.setD
  | .push j n d => LiftR (DataStack.PushStep k j n d C.toD) C.setD
  | .mark j => LiftR (DataStack.MarkStep j C.toD) C.setD
  | .rewind j m => LiftR (DataStack.RewindStep k j m C.toD) C.setD
  | .grow j b e => LiftR (DataStack.GrowStep k j b e C.toD) C.setD

/-! ## Executor -/

/-- The first free slot of a slot list and its index (HandlePool v0.5, D.3: "`ok` choisit un
slot libre"; the lowest index is chosen, one of the outcomes the relation allows). -/
def firstFree : List HandlePool.Slot → Option (Nat × HandlePool.Slot)
  | [] => none
  | sl :: l => if sl.live then (firstFree l).map fun p => (p.1 + 1, p.2) else some (0, sl)

/-- An authority that can write the leaf `dst` (§67), searched among the authorities of `s`. -/
def writer (s : S3) (dst : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (List.range s.A.length).find? fun a => decide (Write3Pre s a [dst])

/-- The kernel-side check of a step of `crun` (§67; HandlePool v0.5, D.3): the handle write
of `allocSlot` is a kernel `write` by some authority. -/
def COp.kok (C : CState) : COp → Bool
  | .allocSlot _ dst => (writer C.kern dst).isSome
  | _ => true

section Exec
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- Computed outcome of `allocSlot(pool j, dst)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §58). -/
  | .rewind j m => liftO C.setD (rewindOut k C.toD j m)
  | .grow j b e => liftO C.setD (growOut k C.toD j b e)

/-- The state after `o` from `C` when it is `ok`; `C` otherwise (§58). -/
def cnext (C : CState) (o : COp) : CState :=
  match cstep k C o with
  | .ok C' => C'
  | _ => C

/-- The state reached by `os` from `C` when every step is `ok` and every `allocSlot` handle write
is a kernel write (§58, §67); `none` otherwise. -/
def crun (C : CState) : List COp → Option CState
  | [] => some C
  | o :: os =>
    match cstep k C o with
    | .ok C' => if o.kok C then crun C' os else none
    | _ => none

/-- The state reached by `os` from `CState.init statics` (§47); `CState.init statics` when the run
does not complete (used only under `(crun …).isSome = true`, see `crunsTo`). -/
def cfinal (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) : CState :=
  (crun k (CState.init statics) os).getD (CState.init statics)

end Exec

/-- Combined library states reachable from `CState.init statics` (§47) by `ok` steps of the kernel
and of the three libraries (Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2). -/
inductive CReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : CState → Prop where
  | init : CReach k statics (CState.init statics)
  | step {C C' : CState} {o : COp} : CReach k statics C → CRel k C o (.ok C') →
      CReach k statics C'

section Runs
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A run of `os` from `CState.init statics` (§47) has only `ok` steps and reaches `C`; `C` is
library-reachable, and its kernel state is reachable by O1–O16 (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
structure CRunsTo (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) (C : CState) : Prop where
  /-- Every step is `ok` and the run ends in `C`. -/
  run : crun k (CState.init statics) os = some C
  /-- `C` is library-reachable. -/
  creach : CReach k statics C
  /-- The kernel state of `C` is reachable from `S3.init statics` by O1–O16 (§57). -/
  reach : Reachable k statics C.kern

/-- The run of `os` from `CState.init statics` has only `ok` steps (§47, §57). -/
abbrev CRuns (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) : Prop :=
  CRunsTo k statics os (cfinal k statics os)

end Runs

/-! ## Step soundness (§58) -/

/-- A computed outcome of a projected relation is an outcome of its lift (§58). -/
alike. -/
theorem cstep_sound (C : CState) (o : COp) : CRel k C o (cstep k C o) := by
  cases o with
  | newArena st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | newPool st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | newStack st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | allocSlot j d => exact liftR_liftO (allocSlotOut_sound _ _ _)
  | resolve j h m => exact liftR_liftO (resolveOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | resolveMany j hs m => exact liftR_liftO (resolveManyOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | unresolve c => exact liftR_liftO (unresolveOut_sound _ _)
  | freeSlot j h => exact liftR_liftO (freeSlotOut_sound _ _ _)
  | push j n d => exact liftR_liftO (pushOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | mark j => exact liftR_liftO (markOut_sound _ _)
  | rewind j m => exact liftR_liftO (rewindOut_sound _ _ _)
  | grow j b e => exact liftR_liftO (growOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | _ => exact liftR_liftO (lstep_sound _ _)

/-- A computed `reject` is a `reject` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
theorem crejects {C : CState} {o : COp} (h : verdictOf (cstep k C o) = .reject) :
    CRel k C o .reject := by
  have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
  revert hs h
  cases cstep k C o with
  | ok => intro h; cases h
  | reject => intro _ hs; exact hs
  | fail => intro h; cases h

/-- A computed `fail` is a `fail` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
theorem cfails {C : CState} {o : COp} (h : verdictOf (cstep k C o) = .fail) :
    CRel k C o .fail := by
  have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
  revert hs h
  cases cstep k C o with
  | ok => intro h; cases h
  | reject => intro h; cases h
  | fail => intro _ hs; exact hs

/-- A computed `ok` is the `ok` outcome of the relation to `cnext k C o` (§58). -/
theorem coks {C : CState} {o : COp} (h : verdictOf (cstep k C o) = .ok) :
    CRel k C o (.ok (cnext k C o)) := by
  have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
  unfold cnext
  revert hs h
  cases cstep k C o with
  | ok => intro _ hs; exact hs
  | reject => intro h; cases h
  | fail => intro h; cases h

end Sound

/-! ## Kernel side of library steps (§57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7; DS-v2) -/

/-- The kernel part of an arena library step is a sequence of kernel steps (Part XIV, §57:
`newArena` changes no kernel component, `issue` is `split` then `store`, `reset` is `derive` then
`release`). -/
theorem LStep.kseq {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') :
    HandlePool.KSeq k L.kern L'.kern := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact .single hk
  | newArena hs => rw [newArena_kernel hs]; exact .refl _
  | issue hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact (HandlePool.KSeq.single (.split hsp)).tail (.store hst)
  | reset hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hd hrl _ => exact (HandlePool.KSeq.single (.derive hd)).tail (.release hrl)

/-- The kernel part of an `ok` step of the combined library (§57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5,
D.2, D.3, HP5-7; DS-v2): a finite sequence of kernel steps O1–O16 when the step passes the check
`kok`; `newPool`, `freeSlot` (no kernel effect, HP5-1), `newStack` and `mark` are the identity. -/
theorem crel_kside {k : K} {C C' : CState} {o : COp} (h : CRel k C o (.ok C'))
    (hw : o.kok C = true) : HandlePool.KSeq k C.kern C'.kern := by
  cases o with
  | newPool st i =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hx
    exact .refl _
  | allocSlot j d =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok =>
      simp only [COp.kok, Option.isSome_iff_exists] at hw
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hw
      exact .single (.write (a := a) (Guarded.ok (writer_sound ha)))
  | resolve j h m =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ hR _ hE =>
      exact (HandlePool.KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).tail (.derive (Guarded.ok hE))
  | resolveMany j hs m =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ hR hE =>
      exact (HandlePool.KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).trans
        (HandlePool.entries_kseq hE)
  | unresolve c =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ hr => exact HandlePool.releaseAll_kseq hr
  | freeSlot j h =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok => exact .refl _
  | newStack st i =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hx
    exact .refl _
  | push j n d =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact (HandlePool.KSeq.single (.split hsp)).tail (.store hst)
  | mark j =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ => exact .refl _
  | rewind j m =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ _ hsp hrl => exact (HandlePool.KSeq.single (.split hsp)).tail (.release hrl)
  | grow j b e =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ hrl _ _ _ hsp hst =>
      exact ((HandlePool.KSeq.single (.release hrl)).tail (.split hsp)).tail (.store hst)
  | newArena st i =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    exact LStep.kseq (.newArena hx)
  | _ =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    exact LStep.kseq (opRel_ok hx)

section RunSound
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A completed run from a library-reachable state whose kernel state is reachable ends in such a
state (§57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7; DS-v2). -/
theorem crun_reach {statics : Statics} :
    ∀ {C C' : CState} {os : List COp}, CReach k statics C →
      Reachable k statics C.kern → crun k C os = some C' →
      CReach k statics C' ∧ Reachable k statics C'.kern
  | _, _, [], hC, hr, h => by cases h; exact ⟨hC, hr⟩
  | C, _, o :: os, hC, hr, h => by
    unfold crun at h
    have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
    cases e : cstep k C o with
    | ok C₁ =>
      rw [e] at h hs
      dsimp only at h
      split at h
      · next hw => exact crun_reach (.step hC hs) ((crel_kside hs hw).reachable hr) h
      · cases h
    | reject => rw [e] at h; cases h
    | fail => rw [e] at h; cases h

/-- **Run soundness** (§47, §57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2): when the run of `os` from
`CState.init statics` completes, it reaches `cfinal k statics os`, which is library-reachable and
whose kernel state is reachable by O1–O16. -/
theorem crunsTo {statics : Statics} {os : List COp}
    (h : (crun k (CState.init statics) os).isSome = true) : CRuns k statics os := by
  have hr : crun k (CState.init statics) os = some (cfinal k statics os) := by
    unfold cfinal
    cases e : crun k (CState.init statics) os with
    | none => rw [e] at h; cases h
    | some C => rfl
  obtain ⟨hc, hk⟩ := crun_reach .init .init hr
  exact ⟨hr, hc, hk⟩

end RunSound

end Ern.Corpus.LibRunner

/-!
# Corpus DataStack: the stack library (test module)

Cases of the library instance `DataStack` of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, run on
the reference kernel (§60–§75) through the library of `Ern.Lib.DataStack`. The spec does not define
the contract (Part XIV preamble: "The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their
library abstractions and are not defined here"); the contract is DS-v2, non-normative, stated in the
module docstring of `Ern.Lib.DataStack`. This is a test module: no model or library module imports
it.

* `DOp`: a kernel operation O1–O16 of the corpus runner (`Ern.Corpus.Runner`), or a stack
  operation `newStack`, `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow` (DS-v2).
* `dstep k D o`: the computed outcome (§58); `dstep_sound`: it is an outcome of the relation of the
  operation (`DOpRel`: the kernel relation with the stack metadata unchanged, `NewStackStep`,
  `PushStep`, `MarkStep`, `RewindStep`, `GrowStep`), `ok`, `reject` and `fail` alike.
* `druns`: a run from `DState.init statics` (§47) whose steps are all `ok` reaches a state that is
  library-reachable (`DReach`) and whose kernel state is reachable by O1–O16 (§57,
  `DReach.reachable`).
* `newStack` consults the stack registry and no other (§56, `others = []`): the library states of
  these runs hold no administration other than stacks.

Each case states the reached state with `DRunsTo`, the verdict of the step under test with the
relation of its operation on that state (decided by `decide`; `rewind_dead_fails` adds that `fail`
is the only outcome), and its positive twin (the same sequence without the faulty element,
accepted). Its docstring gives the expected verdict from its source (the stack contract of the
brief, DS-v1, whose text DS-v2 keeps and the cases quote as DS-v2; the brief's ABA and multi-stack
frame scenarios; the draft DataStack cases of the derivability material, non-normative, which settle
no verdict alone), the obtained verdict, the class (`Lib`: library instance) and the twin. The
source material is no longer available: each source verdict is the one recorded by the spec v0
edition of this module and by the corpus map of the reconstruction. Where DS-v2 changes the verdict
a source gave, the docstring records the historical expected verdict, its justification, the new
expected verdict, derived from the text of the deciding DS-v2 item, and that item: the third `grow`
of DS03 and DS05, both "to arbitrate" under DS-v1. A case whose obtained verdict differs from the
expected one would be kept with its expected verdict and marked **MISMATCH**; none does.

DS-v2 items on which a verdict or arrival state depends: DS2-1 at every `mark` (`AdminRight` holds
on the stack of each); DS2-2 at every `grow` (the block of each is held by its recorded destination:
no block value is transferred); DS2-4 at every `rewind` (no cell at a position `≥` the current top
is covered, so the cells that decide are those between the top of the mark and the top, as in the
spec v0 edition of this module); the dead or foreign mark `fail` before the right (DS02, DS06,
DS08); `push` without room `fail` (DS05); `grow` of a `b` that is no block `reject` (DS03); §76.5
and §76.6 at every `newStack`. DS2-3 (a dead stack), DS2-5 (`grow` with `extra = 0`) and DS2-6
(`rewind` on a missing stack) occur in no case here; their examples are in `Ern.Lib.DataStack`
(`Witness.dead_stack_marks_fail`, `Witness.grow_zero_reissues`,
`Witness.rewind_missing_stack_fails`).

Not encoded: the draft `case_rewind_reading` (its reading of "above the mark" is decided by DS2-4,
example `Witness.rewind_rejects_above_top` of `Ern.Lib.DataStack`, under which its `rewind` with a
covered cell above the current top is `reject`); the draft `case_static_before_fail` other than its
`push` without room (its `Init`-destination conjuncts are changed by §77.2); the kernel `newArena`
conjuncts of the draft `case_stacks` (the stack-library state holds no arena registry; the
cross-registry cases of §56 are another module).
-/

namespace Ern.Corpus.DataStack

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena Ern.Corpus Ern.Lib.DataStack

/-- The kernel operations O1–O16 among the operations of the corpus runner (§60–§75): every
operation but the arena operations O17–O19 of Part XIV, which are not steps of the stack library
(DS-v2). -/
def kernelOp : Op → Bool
  | .newArena .. | .issue .. | .reset .. => false
  | _ => true

/-- An operation of a stack-library run (DS-v2, non-normative): a kernel operation O1–O16
(§60–§75) of non-administrative code, or a stack operation `newStack`, `push`, `mark`, `rewind`,
`grow`, with its arguments. -/
inductive DOp where
  | kernel (o : Op) (h : kernelOp o = true := by decide)
  | newStack (storage internal : Nat)
  | push (j size dst : Nat)
  | mark (j : Nat)
  | rewind (j : Nat) (m : Mark)
  | grow (j b extra : Nat)

/-- A kernel relation (§60–§75) read on stack-library outcomes (DS-v2): the kernel outcome, with
the stack registry and the fresh mark identifier unchanged on `ok`. -/
def KRelD (R : Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop
  | .ok D' => R (.ok D'.kern) ∧ D'.stacks = D.stacks ∧ D'.fresh = D.fresh
  | .reject => R .reject
  | .fail => R .fail

/-- The relation of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75); none for the arena operations, which are
not steps of the stack library (DS-v2). -/
def kRel (k : K) (s : S3) : Op → Outcome3 S3 → Prop
  | .derive src r m => DeriveStep src r m s
  | .split src rs => SplitStep k src rs s
  | .release a => ReleaseStep a s
  | .transfer src dst => TransferStep k src dst s
  | .depend q x => DependStep q x s
  | .enter ps ls => EnterStep ps ls s
  | .exit => ExitStep k s
  | .read a ls => Read3Step a ls s
  | .write a ls => Write3Step a ls s
  | .writeShared a ls => WriteSharedStep k a ls s
  | .pin p => PinStep p s
  | .unpin p => UnpinStep k p s
  | .endUse p => EndUseStep k p s
  | .free p auth => FreeStep k p auth s
  | .alloc pr ow ls => AllocStep k pr ow ls s
  | .store a p => StoreStep a p s
  | .newArena .. | .issue .. | .reset .. => fun _ => False

/-- The relation of a stack-library operation from `D` (DS-v2, non-normative; §58): the kernel
relation of O1–O16 with the stack metadata unchanged; `NewStackStep` with no other registry
(§56: the library states of these runs hold stacks only), `PushStep`, `MarkStep`, `RewindStep`,
`GrowStep`. -/
def DOpRel (k : K) (D : DState) : DOp → Outcome3 DState → Prop
  | .kernel o _ => KRelD (kRel k D.kern o) D
  | .newStack st i => NewStackStep [] st i D
  | .push j size dst => PushStep k j size dst D
  | .mark j => MarkStep j D
  | .rewind j m => RewindStep k j m D
  | .grow j b extra => GrowStep k j b extra D

section Exec
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A kernel outcome computed by the corpus runner, read on stack-library states (§58; DS-v2):
the stack metadata unchanged on `ok`. -/
def liftK (D : DState) : Outcome3 LState → Outcome3 DState
  | .ok L => .ok ⟨L.kern, D.stacks, D.fresh⟩
  | .reject => .reject
  | .fail => .fail

| .fail => .fail

/-- The computed outcome of a stack-library operation from `D` (DS-v2, non-normative; §58): the
kernel operations by the corpus runner on the kernel state; the stack operations by the order of
the checks of their relations. -/
def dstep (D : DState) : DOp → Outcome3 DState
  | .kernel o _ => liftK D (lstep k ⟨D.kern, []⟩ o)
  | .newStack st i =>
    if NewStackPre D.kern D.stacks [] st i then .ok (newStackEff D st i) else .reject
  | .push j size dst =>
    match D.stacks[j]? with
    | none => .reject
    | some st =>
      if IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst then
        if st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length then
          if SplitPre k D.kern st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] then
            if StorePre (splitEff D.kern st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size]) D.kern.A.length
                dst then
              .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff D.kern st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size])
                  D.kern.A.length dst,
                D.stacks.set j (pushMeta st size D.kern.A.length dst), D.fresh⟩
            else .reject
          else .reject
        else .fail
      else .reject
  | .mark j =>
    match D.stacks[j]? with
    | none => .reject
    | some st =>
      if AdminRight D.kern st then .ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩
      else .reject
  | .rewind j m =>
    match D.stacks[j]? with
    | none => .fail
    | some st =>
      if LiveMark D.kern j st m then
        if AdminRight D.kern st then
          if SplitPre k D.kern st.internal [above st m] then
            if ReleasePre (splitEff D.kern st.internal [above st m]) D.kern.A.length then
              .ok ⟨releaseEff (splitEff D.kern st.internal [above st m]) D.kern.A.length,
                D.stacks.set j (rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩
            else .reject
          else .reject
        else .reject
      else .fail
  | .grow j b extra =>
    match D.stacks[j]? with
    | none => .reject
    | some st =>
      match st.block b with
      | none => .reject
      | some x =>
        if ReleasePre D.kern b then
          match holderPlace D.kern b with
          | none => .reject
          | some d =>
            if IssueStatic (releaseEff D.kern b) st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra))
                d then
              if InPlace st x extra then
                if SplitPre k (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
                    [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] then
                  if StorePre (splitEff (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
                      [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)]) (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length d then
                    .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
                        [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)]) (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length d,
                      D.stacks.set j (growMeta st x extra (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length d),
                      D.fresh⟩
                  else .reject
                else .reject
              else .fail
            else .reject
        else .reject

/-- The state reached by the operations `os` from `D` when every step is `ok` (§58; DS-v2);
`none` as soon as a step is not `ok`. -/
def drun (D : DState) : List DOp → Option DState
  | [] => some D
  | o :: os =>
    match dstep k D o with
    | .ok D' => drun D' os
    | _ => none

/-- The state reached by `os` from `DState.init statics` (§47; DS-v2); `DState.init statics` when a
step is not `ok` (used only under `(drun …).isSome = true`, see `druns`). -/
def dfinal (statics : Statics) (os : List DOp) : DState :=
  (drun k (DState.init statics) os).getD (DState.init statics)

/-- A run of `os` from `DState.init statics` (§47; DS-v2) has only `ok` steps and reaches `D`; `D`
is library-reachable (`DReach`) and its kernel state is reachable (§57). -/
structure DRunsTo (statics : Statics) (os : List DOp) (D : DState) : Prop where
  /-- Every step of the run is `ok` and the run ends in `D`. -/
  run : drun k (DState.init statics) os = some D
  /-- `D` is reachable by library steps (DS-v2). -/
  dreach : DReach k statics D
  /-- The kernel state of `D` is reachable from `S3.init statics` by O1–O16 (§36, §57). -/
  reach : Reachable k statics D.kern

/-- The run of `os` from `DState.init statics` has only `ok` steps (§47, §57; DS-v2). -/
abbrev DRuns (statics : Statics) (os : List DOp) : Prop :=
  DRunsTo k statics os (dfinal k statics os)

end Exec

/-! ## Soundness -/

/-- An `ok` outcome of the relation of a stack-library operation is a library step (DS-v2;
§57): a kernel step O1–O16 with the stack metadata unchanged, or a stack operation. -/
theorem dopRel_ok {k : K} {D D' : DState} : ∀ {o : DOp}, DOpRel k D o (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
  | .kernel o _, h => by
    obtain ⟨h, e1, e2⟩ := h
    have hD : D' = ⟨D'.kern, D.stacks, D.fresh⟩ := by rw [← e1, ← e2]
    rw [hD]
    refine .kernel ?_
    cases o with
    | derive => exact .derive h
    | split => exact .split h
    | release => exact .release h
    | transfer => exact .transfer h
    | depend => exact .depend h
    | enter => exact .enter h
    | exit => exact .exit h
    | read => exact .read h
    | write => exact .write h
    | writeShared => exact .writeShared h
    | pin => exact .pin h
    | unpin => exact .unpin h
    | endUse => exact .endUse h
    | free => exact .free h
    | alloc => exact .alloc h
    | store => exact .store h
    | newArena => exact h.elim
    | issue => exact h.elim
    | reset => exact h.elim
  | .newStack .., h => .newStack h
  | .push .., h => .push h
  | .mark .., h => .mark h
  | .rewind .., h => .rewind h
  | .grow .., h => .grow h

section Sound
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A kernel outcome of the corpus runner, read on stack-library states, is an outcome of the
kernel relation with the stack metadata unchanged (§58; DS-v2). -/
theorem liftK_sound {R : Outcome3 S3 → Prop} {D : DState} {out : Outcome3 LState}
    (h : KRel R [] out) : KRelD R D (liftK D out) := by
  cases out with
  | ok L => exact ⟨h.1, rfl, rfl⟩
  | reject => exact h
  | fail => exact h

/-- **Step soundness** (§58, §60–§75; DS-v2): the computed outcome of `o` from `D` is an outcome
of the relation of `o`, `ok`, `reject` and `fail` alike. -/
theorem dstep_sound (D : DState) (o : DOp) : DOpRel k D o (dstep k D o) := by
  cases o with
  | kernel o h =>
    have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) ⟨D.kern, []⟩ o
    cases o <;> first | exact liftK_sound hs | simp [kernelOp] at h
  | newStack st i =>
    show NewStackStep [] st i D _
    dsimp only [dstep]
    split
    · next h => exact .ok h
    · next h => exact .reject h
  | mark j =>
    show MarkStep j D _
    dsimp only [dstep]
    split
    · next h => exact .noStack h
    · next st h =>
      split
      · next ha => exact .ok h ha
      · next ha => exact .static h ha
  | push j size dst =>
    show PushStep k j size dst D _
    dsimp only [dstep]
    split
    · next h => exact .noStack h
    · next st h =>
      split
      · next h1 =>
        split
        · next h2 =>
          split
          · next h3 =>
            split
            · next h4 => exact .ok h h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.ok h4)
            · next h4 => exact .store h h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.reject h4)
          · next h3 => exact .split h h1 h2 (.reject h3)
        · next h2 => exact .fail h h1 h2
      · next h1 => exact .static h h1
  | rewind j m =>
    show RewindStep k j m D _
    dsimp only [dstep]
    split
    · next h => exact .noStack h
    · next st h =>
      split
      · next h1 =>
        split
        · next h2 =>
          split
          · next h3 =>
            split
            · next h4 => exact .ok h h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.ok h4)
            · next h4 => exact .release h h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.reject h4)
          · next h3 => exact .split h h1 h2 (.reject h3)
        · next h2 => exact .static h h1 h2
      · next h1 => exact .dead h h1
  | grow j b extra =>
    show GrowStep k j b extra D _
    dsimp only [dstep]
    split
    · next h => exact .noStack h
    · next st h =>
      split
      · next hb => exact .noBlock h hb
      · next x hb =>
        split
        · next h0 =>
          split
          · next hh => exact .noHolder h hb (.ok h0) hh
          · next d hh =>
            split
            · next hs =>
              split
              · next hi =>
                split
                · next h1 =>
                  split
                  · next h2 => exact .ok h hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi (.ok h1) (.ok h2)
                  · next h2 => exact .store h hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi (.ok h1) (.reject h2)
                · next h1 => exact .split h hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi (.reject h1)
              · next hi => exact .fail h hb (.ok h0) hh hs hi
            · next hs => exact .static h hb (.ok h0) hh hs
        · next h0 => exact .release h hb (.reject h0)

/-- An `ok` computed step is a library step (DS-v2; §58). -/
theorem dstep_ok {D D' : DState} {o : DOp} (h : dstep k D o = .ok D') : DStep k D D' :=
  dopRel_ok (h ▸ dstep_sound D o)

/-- A run whose steps are all `ok`, from a library-reachable state, ends in a library-reachable
state (DS-v2; §47). -/
theorem drun_reach {statics : Statics} :
    ∀ {D D' : DState} {os : List DOp}, DReach k statics D → drun k D os = some D' →
      DReach k statics D'
  | _, _, [], hD, h => by cases h; exact hD
  | D, _, o :: os, hD, h => by
    unfold drun at h
    cases hs : dstep k D o with
    | ok D₁ => rw [hs] at h; exact drun_reach (.step hD (dstep_ok hs)) h
    | reject => rw [hs] at h; cases h
    | fail => rw [hs] at h; cases h

/-- **Run soundness** (§47, §57; DS-v2): when every step of `os` from `DState.init statics` is
`ok`, the run reaches `dfinal k statics os`, which is library-reachable and whose kernel state is
reachable by O1–O16 (`DReach.reachable`). -/
theorem druns {statics : Statics} {os : List DOp}
    (h : (drun k (DState.init statics) os).isSome = true) : DRuns k statics os := by
  have hr : drun k (DState.init statics) os = some (dfinal k statics os) := by
    unfold dfinal
    cases e : drun k (DState.init statics) os with
    | none => rw [e] at h; cases h
    | some D => rfl
  have hd := drun_reach .init hr
  exact ⟨hr, hd, hd.reachable⟩

/-- A computed `reject` is a `reject` outcome of the relation (§58; DS-v2). -/
theorem drejects {D : DState} {o : DOp} (h : verdictOf (dstep k D o) = .reject) :
    DOpRel k D o .reject := by
  have hs := dstep_sound (k := k) D o
  revert hs h
  cases dstep k D o with
  | ok => intro h; cases h
  | reject => intro _ hs; exact hs
  | fail => intro h; cases h

/-- A computed `fail` is a `fail` outcome of the relation (§58; DS-v2). -/
theorem dfails {D : DState} {o : DOp} (h : verdictOf (dstep k D o) = .fail) :
    DOpRel k D o .fail := by
  have hs := dstep_sound (k := k) D o
  revert hs h
  cases dstep k D o with
  | ok => intro h; cases h
  | reject => intro h; cases h
  | fail => intro _ hs; exact hs

end Sound

/-! ## Test contract and shapes (§48, §72) -/

/-- The empty test contract (§48): nothing shared, pinned, externally done or deallocable. -/
abbrev K0 : K := KD.toK {}

/-- A root leaf of a local shape (§72, §71.1). -/
abbrev lf : Option Nat × Nat := (none, 0)

/-- A leaf part of the shape element `p` (§72, §71.1). -/
abbrev pt (p : Nat) : Option Nat × Nat := (some p, 0)

/-- One stack (DS-v2, §72, §60, §65, §76 read for a stack): frame 1 with the stack value 0, the
storage 1 with the cells 2, 3, 4, and the destinations 5, 6, 7 (root authorities 0 on 0, 1 on 1,
2 on 5, 3 on 6, 4 on 7); `internal` 5, `Modify` derived from the root of the storage on its cells,
stored into the stack value; stack 0 created on 1 with `internal` 5. -/
def setup1 : List DOp :=
  [.kernel (.enter [] [lf, lf, pt 1, pt 1, pt 1, lf, lf, lf]),
    .kernel (.derive 1 [2, 3, 4] .modify), .kernel (.store 5 0), .newStack 1 5]

/-! ## One stack: `rewind`, marks, `grow`, `push` (DS-v2) -/

/-- Run of DS01 (DS-v2): mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`; `push` of 2 cells into 5 (block 6 on `[2, 3]`); mark
`⟨0, 1, 2⟩`; `push` of 1 cell into 6 (block 7 on `[4]`). -/
def ds01o : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 2 5, .mark 0, .push 0 1 6]
/-- State reached by `ds01o` (§57; DS-v2). -/
def ds01 : DState := dfinal K0 [] ds01o

/-- **DS01** (draft `case_rewind`; DS-v2 "rewind m … rejects if an active authority derived from
internal covers a cell above m, otherwise returns those cells to available and removes m and every
mark above it", with DS2-4: a cell above m is a cell at a position `≥ m.top`; class Lib).
`rewind ⟨0, 1, 2⟩` while block 7, active and derived from `internal` 5, covers cell 4, at position
2, above the mark; then after the program releases 7. Expected (DS-v2, draft):
`reject`, then `ok` with top 2, block 6 kept, mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` kept. Obtained: `reject` (`split` of
`internal` on `[4]` rejected, §43 case 3, §61.1), then `ok` with that metadata (§62, §61). Twins:
the same sequence without the second `push`, `ok`; and the run with `release(7)` before the
`rewind`, `ok`. -/
theorem DS01 : DRunsTo K0 [] ds01o ds01 ∧
    ds01.kern.A[7]? = some ⟨.modify, some 5, [4], .place 6, true⟩ ∧
    RewindStep K0 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩ ds01 .reject ∧
    DRuns K0 [] (setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 2 5, .mark 0, .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩]) ∧
    DRuns K0 [] (ds01o ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩]) ∧
    (dfinal K0 [] (ds01o ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩])).stacks =
      [⟨1, 5, [2, 3, 4], 2, [⟨0, 2, 6, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩]⟩] :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), by decide, drejects (k := K0) (o := .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩) (by decide),
    druns (by decide), druns (by decide), by decide⟩

/-- Run of DS02 (DS-v2): the run of DS01, `release(7)`, `rewind ⟨0, 1, 2⟩` (top back to 2), then a
new mark at the same top: `⟨0, 2, 2⟩`. -/
def ds02o : List DOp := ds01o ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩, .mark 0]
/-- State reached by `ds02o` (§57; DS-v2). -/
def ds02 : DState := dfinal K0 [] ds02o

/-- **DS02** (draft `case_aba`; DS-v2 "Marks carry stack identity and a fresh mark identifier";
"rewind m fails on a dead … mark"; class Lib). ABA: the top is back at 2, the top of the removed
mark `⟨0, 1, 2⟩`, and a new mark `⟨0, 2, 2⟩` is live there. Expected (DS-v2, draft): `rewind` of the
removed mark `fail`, of the new mark `ok`. Obtained: `fail`, with no other outcome (§58;
`rewind_dead_fails`), and `ok`. Twin of the `fail`: `rewind` of the new mark at the same position,
`ok`. -/
theorem DS02 : DRunsTo K0 [] ds02o ds02 ∧
    ds02.stacks = [⟨1, 5, [2, 3, 4], 2, [⟨0, 2, 6, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 2, 2⟩]⟩] ∧
    (RewindStep K0 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩ ds02 .fail ∧ ∀ o, RewindStep K0 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩ ds02 o → o = .fail) ∧
    DRuns K0 [] (ds02o ++ [.rewind 0 ⟨0, 2, 2⟩]) :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), by decide,
    rewind_dead_fails (st := ⟨1, 5, [2, 3, 4], 2, [⟨0, 2, 6, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 2, 2⟩]⟩)
      (by decide) (by decide),
    druns (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of DS03 (DS-v2): the run of DS02, then `grow` of block 6 (`[2, 3]`, at the top) by one
cell. -/
def ds03o : List DOp := ds02o ++ [.grow 0 6 1]
/-- State reached by `ds03o` (§57; DS-v2). -/
def ds03 : DState := dfinal K0 [] ds03o

/-- **DS03** (draft `case_grow`; DS-v2 "grow is in place only (same base, extension into the space
directly after the block, fail otherwise)", DS2-2 "grow stores the new block authority into the
place that currently holds the block authority b", and "grow of a b that is no block of the stack
is reject"; class Lib). `grow(6, 1)` with one cell after the block; then `grow(9, 1)` with no cell
left; then `grow(6, 1)` of the replaced block.
Expected: `ok` (DS-v2: block `⟨0, 3, 9, 5⟩` of the same base, authority 9 on `[2, 3, 4]`, stored
into place 5, which holds block 6: no block value is transferred, so it is also the recorded
destination), then `fail` (DS-v2 "fail otherwise": no cell follows the block).
For the replaced block, the verdict changes with DS-v2. Historical expected verdict (DS-v1): none,
to arbitrate. Justification: DS-v1 says nothing of a `b` that is no block of the stack (the
`reject` of the draft `case_grow` is module behaviour, not a source), and the v0 edition of this
case marked it **MISMATCH** in form against the obtained `reject`. New expected verdict: `reject`,
decided by the DS-v2 item "`grow` of a `b` that is no block of the stack is `reject`" (Q11 (b),
DS-R5): 6 is no block of the stack after the first `grow`.
Obtained: `ok` (`release`, `split`, `store` into the holder 5, §62, §61, §65) with that block and
footprint; `fail` (no room, availability §77.4); `reject` (6 is no block of the stack). Twin of the
`fail` and of the `reject`: `grow(6, 1)` with one cell after the block, the `ok` step of this run.
-/
theorem DS03 : DRunsTo K0 [] ds03o ds03 ∧
    ds03.stacks = [⟨1, 5, [2, 3, 4], 3, [⟨0, 3, 9, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 2, 2⟩]⟩] ∧
    ds03.kern.afp 9 = [2, 3, 4] ∧
    GrowStep K0 0 9 1 ds03 .fail ∧ GrowStep K0 0 6 1 ds03 .reject :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), by decide, by decide, dfails (k := K0) (o := .grow 0 9 1) (by decide),
    drejects (k := K0) (o := .grow 0 6 1) (by decide)⟩

/-- **DS04** (DS-v2 "grow is in place only (…, extension into the space directly after the block,
fail otherwise)"; class Lib). In the state of DS01, `grow(6, 1)` of block 6 (`[2, 3]`), live but not
the last one: block 7 occupies cell 4 after it. Expected (DS-v2, "fail otherwise"; DS2-5 does not
apply, `extra` is 1): `fail` (the draft's `grow`, which handled the last block only, rejected).
Obtained: `fail` (release of 6, the holder 5 of 6 found, DS2-2, static checks, then `InPlace`
fails, §77.4). Twin: the same sequence without the second `push`, `ok`. -/
theorem DS04 : DRunsTo K0 [] ds01o ds01 ∧ GrowStep K0 0 6 1 ds01 .fail ∧
    DRuns K0 [] (setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 2 5, .mark 0, .grow 0 6 1]) :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), dfails (k := K0) (o := .grow 0 6 1) (by decide), druns (by decide)⟩

/-- State reached by `setup1` (§57; DS-v2): stack 0 with 3 cells, top 0. -/
def ds05 : DState := dfinal K0 [] setup1

/-- **DS05** (draft `case_static_before_fail`, `push 0 4 5`; DS-v2 "push and grow use the derived
issue" and "push without room is fail"; class Lib). `push` of 4 cells into 5 on a stack of 3 cells.
The verdict changes with DS-v2. Historical expected verdict (DS-v1): none, to arbitrate.
Justification: DS-v1 does not settle a `push` without room; the reading DS-R7 gave `fail`
(availability, §77.4), its recorded alternative `reject` ("region belongs to the administered
storage", §77.2, static), and the v0 edition of this case marked it **MISMATCH** in form against
the obtained `fail`. New expected verdict: `fail`, decided by the DS-v2 item "`push` without room is
`fail`" (Q11 (a), DS-R7): only 3 cells are left. Obtained: `fail` (static checks of §77.1, §77.2
hold, then no room; availability §77.4). Twin: `push` of the 3 cells, `ok`. -/
theorem DS05 : DRunsTo K0 [] setup1 ds05 ∧ PushStep K0 0 4 5 ds05 .fail ∧
    DRuns K0 [] (setup1 ++ [.push 0 3 5]) :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), dfails (k := K0) (o := .push 0 4 5) (by decide), druns (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of DS06 (DS-v2): mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`, `push` of one cell into 5 (block 6), mark `⟨0, 1, 1⟩`,
`release(6)`, `rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩`. -/
def ds06o : List DOp :=
  setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 5, .mark 0, .kernel (.release 6), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩]
/-- State reached by `ds06o` (§57; DS-v2). -/
def ds06 : DState := dfinal K0 [] ds06o

/-- **DS06** (DS-v2, brief obligation 6: "rewind m fails on a dead or foreign mark" and "removes
m and every mark above it"; class Lib). `rewind ⟨0, 1, 1⟩` after `rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩`
removed it as a later mark. Expected (DS-v2): `fail`. Obtained: `fail`, with no other outcome (§58;
`rewind_dead_fails`); both marks are gone. Twin: the same sequence without `rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩`:
`rewind ⟨0, 1, 1⟩`, `ok`. -/
theorem DS06 : DRunsTo K0 [] ds06o ds06 ∧ ds06.stacks = [⟨1, 5, [2, 3, 4], 0, [], []⟩] ∧
    (RewindStep K0 0 ⟨0, 1, 1⟩ ds06 .fail ∧ ∀ o, RewindStep K0 0 ⟨0, 1, 1⟩ ds06 o → o = .fail) ∧
    DRuns K0 [] (setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 5, .mark 0, .kernel (.release 6),
      .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 1⟩]) :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), by decide,
    rewind_dead_fails (st := ⟨1, 5, [2, 3, 4], 0, [], []⟩) (by decide) (by decide),
    druns (by decide)⟩

/-! ## Several stacks (DS-v2; §56) -/

/-- Two stacks (DS-v2, §72, §60, §65, §76 read for a stack): frame 1 with the stack values 0 and 8,
the storages 1 (cells 2, 3, 4) and 9 (cells 10, 11), the destinations 5, 6, 7, 12 (root
authorities 0 on 0, 1 on 1, 2 on 5, 3 on 6, 4 on 7, 5 on 8, 6 on 9, 7 on 12); `internal` 8 on the
cells of 1, stored into 0, stack 0; `internal` 9 on the cells of 9, stored into 8, stack 1. -/
def setup2 : List DOp :=
  [.kernel (.enter [] [lf, lf, pt 1, pt 1, pt 1, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, pt 9, pt 9, lf]),
    .kernel (.derive 1 [2, 3, 4] .modify), .kernel (.store 8 0), .newStack 1 8,
    .kernel (.derive 6 [10, 11] .modify), .kernel (.store 9 8), .newStack 9 9]
/-- State reached by `setup2` (§57; DS-v2). -/
def ds07 : DState := dfinal K0 [] setup2

/-- **DS07** (draft `case_stacks`, first part; §56 "An authority identity may serve as `internal`
for at most one live administrative abstraction"; class Lib). A second `newStack` with `internal`
8, already the `internal` of the live stack 0. Expected (§56, draft): `reject`. Obtained: `reject`
by the guard of §56 alone: the other preconditions (`NewArenaBase`, §76.1–§76.3, §76.5 and §76.6
read for a stack) hold. Twin: the same sequence without the first registration of 8, `ok`. The
draft's conjuncts on a kernel `newArena` have no counterpart here: the stack-library state holds no
arena registry (cross-registry cases of §56 belong to another module). -/
theorem DS07 : DRunsTo K0 [] setup2 ds07 ∧ NewStackStep [] 1 8 ds07 .reject ∧
    NewArenaBase ds07.kern 1 8 ∧ ¬ Guard56 [stackInternals ds07.kern ds07.stacks] 8 ∧
    DRuns K0 [] [.kernel (.enter [] [lf, lf, pt 1, pt 1, pt 1, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, pt 9, pt 9,
      lf]), .kernel (.derive 1 [2, 3, 4] .modify), .kernel (.store 8 0),
      .kernel (.derive 6 [10, 11] .modify), .kernel (.store 9 8), .newStack 9 9, .newStack 1 8] :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), drejects (k := K0) (o := .newStack 1 8) (by decide), by decide, by decide,
    druns (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of DS08 (DS-v2): on the two stacks, mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`; `push` of one cell of stack 0 into 5
(block 10 on `[2]`); `push` of one cell of stack 1 into 12 (block 11 on `[10]`); mark
`⟨1, 1, 1⟩`. -/
def ds08o : List DOp := setup2 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 5, .push 1 1 12, .mark 1]
/-- State reached by `ds08o` (§57; DS-v2). -/
def ds08 : DState := dfinal K0 [] ds08o

/-- **DS08** (draft `case_stacks`, second part; DS-v2, brief obligation 6: "Marks carry stack
identity"; "rewind m fails on a dead or foreign mark"; class Lib). Each stack
has its own top, blocks and marks. `rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩` of stack 0 while block 10 lives; `rewind` of
stack 0 to the mark `⟨1, 1, 1⟩` of stack 1; `rewind` of stack 1 to its mark, then a new `push` on
it. Expected (draft, DS-v2): `reject`, `fail`, `ok`. Obtained: `reject` (§43 case 3, §61.1),
`fail` with no other outcome (§58; `rewind_dead_fails`), `ok`. Twins: after `release(10)`,
`rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩` of stack 0, `ok`; the foreign mark rewound on its own stack, `ok`. -/
theorem DS08 : DRunsTo K0 [] ds08o ds08 ∧
    ds08.stacks = [⟨1, 8, [2, 3, 4], 1, [⟨0, 1, 10, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩]⟩,
      ⟨9, 9, [10, 11], 1, [⟨0, 1, 11, 12⟩], [⟨1, 1, 1⟩]⟩] ∧
    RewindStep K0 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ ds08 .reject ∧
    DRuns K0 [] (ds08o ++ [.kernel (.release 10), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩]) ∧
    (RewindStep K0 0 ⟨1, 1, 1⟩ ds08 .fail ∧ ∀ o, RewindStep K0 0 ⟨1, 1, 1⟩ ds08 o → o = .fail) ∧
    DRuns K0 [] (ds08o ++ [.rewind 1 ⟨1, 1, 1⟩, .push 1 1 6]) :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), by decide, drejects (k := K0) (o := .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩) (by decide),
    druns (by decide),
    rewind_dead_fails (st := ⟨1, 8, [2, 3, 4], 1, [⟨0, 1, 10, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩]⟩) (by decide)
      (by decide),
    druns (by decide)⟩

/-! ## Multi-stack frame scenario (DS-v2; §36, §69, §72, §73) -/

/-- Entry of DS09 (§72, §60; DS-v2): on the two stacks, the caller pushes one cell of stack 0 into
5 (block 10), derives 11 (`Modify` on the stack value 0) and 12 (`Modify` on the stack value 8),
and enters frame 2 with the parameters 11 and 12 and the locals 13 and 14 (root authorities 13,
14). -/
def ds09e : List DOp :=
  setup2 ++ [.push 0 1 5, .kernel (.derive 0 [0] .modify), .kernel (.derive 5 [8] .modify),
    .kernel (.enter [11, 12] [lf, lf])]
/-- Run of DS09 up to the exit (DS-v2): the callee marks both stacks at entry (`⟨0, 0, 1⟩`,
`⟨1, 1, 0⟩`), pushes one cell of stack 0 into its local 13 (block 15 on `[3]`) and two cells of
stack 1 into its local 14 (block 16 on `[10, 11]`). -/
def ds09o : List DOp := ds09e ++ [.mark 0, .mark 1, .push 0 1 13, .push 1 2 14]
/-- State reached by `ds09o` (§57; DS-v2). -/
def ds09 : DState := dfinal K0 [] ds09o
/-- The exit of DS09 (§69, §73; DS-v2): `endUse` of the locals 13 and 14 (their blocks are
released), `rewind` of both stacks to the entry marks, `exitFrame`. -/
def ds09x : List DOp :=
  ds09o ++ [.kernel (.endUse 13), .kernel (.endUse 14), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 1⟩, .rewind 1 ⟨1, 1, 0⟩,
    .kernel .exit]

/-- **DS09** (brief, multi-stack frame scenario; draft `case_frame`, one stack; DS-v2 `mark`,
`push`, `rewind`; §36 `Modify` on each stack value, §69, §72, §73; class Lib). A callee frame marks
two stacks at entry, pushes into its locals from both, and at exit ends its locals, rewinds both
stacks to the entry marks and exits. Expected (brief, draft): every step `ok`, the stacks ending as
at entry; `rewind` before the end of the locals `reject` (draft `case_frame`). DS-v2 and v0.1 keep
these verdicts: the parameters 11 and 12 give the callee `AdminRight` on both stacks, which each
`mark` needs (DS2-1), and no authority that an `endUse` makes inactive has an active descendant
(§69.2). Obtained: every step `ok`; after the exit the stack metadata equal those at entry (block 10
of the caller kept, the callee's blocks and marks removed); `rewind ⟨0, 0, 1⟩` before `endUse`
`reject` (block 15 covers cell 3, at position 1, `≥` the top of the mark, DS2-4; §43 case 3, §61.1).
Twin of the `reject`: after `endUse` of the local 13, the same `rewind`, `ok` (the run `ds09x`). -/
theorem DS09 : DRunsTo K0 [] ds09o ds09 ∧
    ds09.stacks = [⟨1, 8, [2, 3, 4], 2, [⟨0, 1, 10, 5⟩, ⟨1, 1, 15, 13⟩], [⟨0, 0, 1⟩]⟩,
      ⟨9, 9, [10, 11], 2, [⟨0, 2, 16, 14⟩], [⟨1, 1, 0⟩]⟩] ∧
    RewindStep K0 0 ⟨0, 0, 1⟩ ds09 .reject ∧ DRuns K0 [] ds09x ∧
    (dfinal K0 [] ds09x).stacks = (dfinal K0 [] ds09e).stacks :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), by decide, drejects (k := K0) (o := .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 1⟩) (by decide),
    druns (by decide), by decide⟩

/-- Run of DS10 (DS-v2; §72): as DS09, but the callee receives only 11 (`Modify` on the stack value
0) and no right on the stack value 8; it marks stack 0 and pushes one cell of it into its local 13
(block 14). -/
def ds10o : List DOp :=
  setup2 ++ [.push 0 1 5, .kernel (.derive 0 [0] .modify), .kernel (.enter [11] [lf, lf]),
    .mark 0, .push 0 1 13]
/-- State reached by `ds10o` (§57; DS-v2). -/
def ds10 : DState := dfinal K0 [] ds10o

/-- **DS10** (multi-stack frame scenario, right on each stack value; §36 "`MetaRight` requires
`Modify` exercisable on the administering value", §77.1; DS-v2 "push and grow use the derived
issue"; class Lib). The callee, without a right on the stack value 8, pushes two cells of stack 1
into its local 14. Expected (§36, §77.1): `reject`. Its `mark` of stack 0 is `ok` under DS2-1: 11
gives it `AdminRight` on stack 0. Obtained: `reject`: `MetaRight` fails for stack 1, while the
callee has `Modify` on the destination 14. Twin: the same sequence with the parameter
12 (`Modify` on the stack value 8) passed at entry, `ok`. -/
theorem DS10 : DRunsTo K0 [] ds10o ds10 ∧ PushStep K0 1 2 14 ds10 .reject ∧
    ds10.stacks[1]? = some ⟨9, 9, [10, 11], 0, [], []⟩ ∧
    ¬ MetaRight ds10.kern (Stack.entry ⟨9, 9, [10, 11], 0, [], []⟩) ∧
    HasRight ds10.kern .modify 14 ∧
    DRuns K0 [] (ds09e ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 13, .push 1 2 14]) :=
  ⟨druns (by decide), drejects (k := K0) (o := .push 1 2 14) (by decide), by decide, by decide,
    by decide, druns (by decide)⟩

end Ern.Corpus.DataStack

# usage: axcheck.sh Module.Name [Module.Name ...]   (run after lake build of those modules)

F=$SP/axcheck_$$.lean
{
  echo "import Lean"
  for m in "$@"; do echo "import $m"; done
  echo 'open Lean Elab Command in'
  echo '#eval show Lean.Core.CoreM Unit from do'
  echo '  let env ← getEnv'
  printf '  for modName in [%s] do\n' "$(printf '`%s, ' "$@" | sed 's/, $//')"
  cat <<'L'
    let some mod := env.getModuleIdx? modName | throwError "no module"
    let mut all := 0
    let mut thms := 0
    let mut bad : Array (Name × Array Name) := #[]
    for (n, ci) in env.constants.map₁.toList do
      if env.getModuleIdxFor? n == some mod then
        all := all + 1
        if let .thmInfo _ := ci then thms := thms + 1
        let axs ← collectAxioms n
        let extra := axs.filter fun a => a != ``propext && a != ``Quot.sound
        if !extra.isEmpty then bad := bad.push (n, extra)
    IO.println s!"{modName}: constants {all}, theorems {thms}"
    IO.println s!"outside propext, Quot.sound: {bad}"
L
} > $F
